summary: As a neighborhood ages, it may become [[lifeless]] and lose residents. Cooperation between the local government and citizens can help [[revitalize]] the area.
evidence: When this happens, a collaboration between the local government and citizens is an effective way to revitalize the area.
explanation: (1) 도시가 오래되면 동네가 활기를 잃는다(lifeless)는 첫 문장에서, (2) 정부와 시민의 협력이 지역을 되살린다(revitalize)는 둘째 문장에서 찾을 수 있다.
